change: Allow HTTP capacity waiters to retire their caller ownership without waiting for the pool cleanup mutex

regressions: HTTP/1 pool queued timeout and cancellation return before waiter cleanup lock
HTTP/2 pool queued timeout and cancellation return before waiter cleanup lock
unified HTTP pool queued timeout and cancellation return before waiter cleanup lock
before.failure: expired FIFO wait still acquired an uncancelable pool mutex before its stack node could be removed; the fixture had to rescue that mutex
before.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='pool queued timeout and cancellation' --summary all

allocation_failure.tcp_pools: std.testing.checkAllAllocationFailures covers initialization, URI staging and waiting-node registration; every failed call releases admission mutex and preserves the original leased slot
allocation_failure.shared_budget: direct and reclaiming registration return OutOfMemory with an unlocked mutex, no queued node and the original reservation; releasing that slot permits retry with the same failing allocator

notification.queue_authority: FIFO head under the owning pool mutex
notification.sleep_hint: shared epoch changes prompt ownership recheck; hints cannot claim capacity
notification.race: abandonment after the owner's final capacity notification still wakes the successor to recheck and prune
notification.wake_policy: epoch notification wakes sleeping callers; each rechecks FIFO before any claim

admission.pool_mutex: original caller deadline in all four pools
admission.shared_budget_mutex: original caller deadline for direct and reclaiming admission, including shared HTTP/3 request-driver and direct URI acquisition
admission.scope_guard: early allocation failures unlock without leaking a pool or budget reservation

http3.transport: TLS 1.3 over QUIC through SOCKS5 UDP ASSOCIATE

existing_ownership_pattern.behavior: caller and tracker references retain waiting storage through notification; atomic abandonment permits caller departure before list reclamation

hyper.behavior: request callbacks are checked for cancellation before message submission

quic_go.role: independent wire, TLS, endpoint reuse and route-churn oracle
